evidence_spans: on Kimi-Audio, for example, the BF16 text and audio heads of the LLM backbone together occupy 2.41 GB.
CLM-ARCH-0275.statement: Modality-conditioned vocabulary pruning reduces the combined weight footprint of the text and audio output heads from 2.41 GB to 1.21 GB.

CLM-ARCH-0276.statement: EdgeALM running Freeze-Omni under full-duplex mode achieves a first-response latency of 2.97 seconds.

CLM-ARCH-0277.statement: EdgeALM running Mini-Omni under half-duplex mode achieves a first-response latency of 2.21 seconds.

extra_quotes: The proposed EdgeALM is implemented on a single Alveo U50 in an ordinary desktop PC
